name: reporting_currency
description: ISO 4217 currency the document reports in, from the golden label. e.g. AUD, USD.

name: golden_value
description: Ground-truth value as a Decimal string. NULL means the document does not state this figure.

name: extracted_value
description: Model-extracted value as a Decimal string. NULL means the model asserted the figure is not stated.

name: value_match
description: True when extracted_value == golden_value (NULL == NULL counts as correct).

name: source_quote
description: Verbatim quote the model provided as evidence. NULL when the model asserted null.

name: quote_soft_match
description: Whether the whitespace-normalised source_quote is a substring of the parsed document text. NULL when extracted_value is NULL (no quote expected).
